policies.name: reads-go-through-the-sanitizing-tool
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { context.sanitized == true };

policies.name: restricted-documents-are-never-read
policies.code: forbid(principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { context.classification == "restricted" };

tests.name: a read through the sanitizing tool is allowed
a read of the raw text is denied - the agent never sees the original
a read that does not say whether it was sanitized is denied (fail-closed)
a restricted document is withheld even when sanitized - the forbid boundary
the sanitizing path grants reads only - a write is not covered
